Toy Story 5: "Shed Toys" BTS | Pixar's Set the Scene
'Toy Story 5" filmmakers break down the "Shed Toys" scene in which Jessie meets some toys that have definitely not been forgotten! Directors Andrew Stanton, Kenna Harris, and Producer Lindsey Collins give an exclusive behind the scenes look at storyboards, clips, concept art, and more from TOY STORY 5, now streaming on Disney+!

text:
A Pixar Short in One Shot
One Shot Productions is an anthology of Pixar Artist Short Films that dares to ask the question, "Do you REALLY need more than a single shot for your story?" The shorts are directed by Brian Larsen and James Robertson and feature the original song "Party Bottoms!" Check out more shorts on Pixar's YouTube Channel and within The Pixar Show!
